description.p: Slate is an extremely sober, fast, and local-first Markdown notes application designed for Linux desktop. It gives the feeling of opening a fresh sheet of paper: no permanent sidebars, no navigation bars, no accounts, and no sync requirements.

ul.li: Raw Markdown storage (.md) with zero proprietary metadata
Atomic saving with data loss protection
Light, Dark, and System theme integration

description.p: Initial release of Slate Markdown notes application.
